rows.en: Bring it on! Come at me!
Hold it! There's another Kamen Rider here!
Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh! I'll take on as many of you as you like!
Grey Rhinoking of the DARK Destruction Squad! By Professor Gill's command, I will destroy Kamen Rider!!
Wh-what!? Who are you?
Shako Monster, envoy from Makuu! I join the battle now that our negotiations with Doctor Death have succeeded!
What!? Doctor Death? Bah, he's meddling where he's not wanted…
…!? Why are DARK and Makuu working with Shocker?
No way!? Why are DARK and Makuu working with Shocker?
Waaaaagh!
It's going to blow in four minutes!
Damn, three minutes left!
Everyone, get out! Don't worry about me!! It's going to blow in two minutes, hurry and get away!
Everyone, I'm fine. More importantly, evacuate, quickly! It's going to blow in one minute, one minute left!
Hongo!! Kamen Rider!!
You Kamen Riders! Next time, I'll finish you off for good! Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh!!
So, what happened? Was it… Shocker's doing after all?
Yes… Shocker was kidnapping young women to make a cyborg.

Man, I was in a cold sweat! But hey… I'm not gonna die from something like that!

I believed in you guys, too… And look, I'm alive and kicking!

More importantly… Shocker has teamed up with the other organizations. The fights ahead are going to be a real pain.

Yeah…

By the way, Oyassan… What are you doing about that new business?
New business? What's that about?

Ah, well… that. I've decided to drop it.

With new executives showing up and enemies teaming up with each other, for me alone to be thinking about business… I'm downright ashamed of myself, Takeshi.

Until your fight is over, I'll keep Amigo going, no matter what!! Even if not a single customer comes!
Hee hee… Are you sure, Mr. Tachibana? It was a rather lovely dream…

Thank you, [HERO4].

But you know… my dream is all of you. I'm counting on you!
Yay! I'll get to eat Boss's parfaits again!
Sure… come and eat anytime. But no running a tab! Ha ha ha…

Curse you, Kamen Rider! I won't give up over something like this!

Just you wait… I'll defeat you all without fail! Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha…

Having finally declared a joint front with the other organizations, Shocker and its devilish army, now joined by the new executive Ambassador Hell, pursued our heroes as relentlessly as a venomous snake.
How is the Devil Circuit cyborg surgery coming along?

Sir…

The thing is… the diagrams describing the surgical procedure are nowhere to be found, so it's not going well.
What!? Ask Komyoji! He must know!
But that Komyoji is…
One moment… Lord Professor Gill!
A business rival, then? What have you come to sell to our DARK, which sells DARK Robots to countries all over the world?

…!?

Those are…!? The diagrams of the surgical procedure written by Komyoji…!
Heh heh heh… Apfaron, was it? I believe I'll buy those skills of yours…
Defeat all of the Shocker motorcycle corps!
Defeat all Executive Monsters and Shocker Combatants! However, if you do not finish within 5 minutes, Kazuya Taki will die!
You can come out! It's me, Jiro! Here, I've brought food.
Jiro, DARK didn't spot you?
I drew them off on purpose and shook them! I think we'll be safe for a while, but…
Until I see Father, no danger's gonna scare me!
Hee hee…
Wow… this is good. Want some, Jiro?
Masaru!

…………

I didn't mean it like that! Sorry, okay?
Humans are inconvenient… They can't live without eating. Androids are convenient that way.
This does it! All I have to do is swap out the oil capsule in my chest like this!
That's right… You're convenient, Jiro.

Tch… Sis is extra nice only to Jiro!

Ugh, I can't stand to watch!
Masaru, you're awful!
Mitsuko, I need to talk something over with you.
Talk something over?
I want you to hide somewhere safe for a while.

But…

There is! A place where I'm sure they'll welcome us warmly…
Where's that?

Father's friend, Mr. Tobei Tachibana…

He's fighting evil organizations to protect the peace and freedom of humanity… He's a very kind person.

I see… You'll be safe with Mr. Tachibana.

Those folks there helped me out once too… Why didn't I think of it sooner!

All right, for now… wait for me there!
What about you, Jiro?
Ha ha ha… Don't worry! I'll rescue the doctor and come for you, I promise.

Professor Gill! The Devil Circuit cyborg surgery… is fully complete!

The result is a great success…
Well done! Then let me see the fruits of your labor…

Come out! Come out, Hakaider!!

Warrior of evil… Hakaider, the pride of DARK's cyborgs! You have only one enemy in this world: Kikaider alone!

Go! Go, Hakaider!! Make full use of the Devil Circuit built into your body!

Hunt Kikaider down wherever he goes! And then, and then… and then, kill him!!
Waaaaagh…
Gwah…
Ugyaaah…
Ha ha ha ha… That's it! That's it, Hakaider!!
Whoa!
Ha ha ha…
Phew… don't scare me like that!
I thought you had nerves of steel, Oyassan, but you're only human after all.
More importantly, seeing you two here together, you must have a lot of time on your hands, eh?
Shocker's been lying totally low lately.
So we get to train hard, thanks to that.
By the way, where's Hongo?

Hmm… Apparently there's some important research he's working on.

He'd like to train with you two himself, but there's the research too, you see?

Juggling both, I bet he's pretty frustrated.
Mr. Tachibana, it's terrible!
Unicorn's Japan Branch code-breaking team has been attacked by BF.
